card.name: Response to treatment wording
card.fires_on: Words right after "response" or "effectiveness" that lead into what the response is to, mostly "to" in "impaired response to these therapies". It also fires on "following" after drug-level data.

modes.label: Response to therapy
modes.description: The word "to" after "response" or "responses" in drug interaction warnings.
modes.example: may have impaired response<< to>> these therapies when taking NSAIDs

modes.label: Effectiveness or following
modes.description: A linking word or noun after a statement about drug effect or pharmacokinetics.
modes.example: ethinyl estradiol<< following>> administration of tablets containing 2.5

card.writes: The suppressed tokens look like noise, and the promoted tokens mean "still", so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the spot after "response" where the text says what the response is to, as in a drug interaction warning.
